title: Structural Conditional Independence Test via Neural Quantile Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.07165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conditional independence testing is difficult when dependence is weak, localized, or expressed through distributional changes rather than a global mean shift. Existing tests usually return a scalar statistic or p-value, which summarizes evidence against independence but does not describe where the conditional law changes. We propose QRCIT, a quantile-resolution conditional independence test that compares P(X|Z) and P(X|Y,Z) through a quantile deformation learned by a shared model. A lightweight residual quantile-flow model first learns the baseline conditional quantile law and then learns the additional deformation induced by Y, yielding a global predictive-gain statistic with conditional-randomization calibration and an inspectable deformation field over context and quantile level. translated_title: 基于神经分位数分辨的结构条件独立性检验
translated_abstract: 当依赖关系微弱、局限于局部，或表现为分布变化而非全局均值偏移时，条件独立性检验十分困难。现有检验通常返回一个标量统计量或p值，它只是汇总了反对独立性的证据，却无法描述条件分布在何处发生了变化。我们提出QRCIT，一种分位数分辨的条件独立性检验方法，它通过共享模型学习到的分位数形变来比较P(X|Z)与P(X|Y,Z)。一个轻量级的残差分位数流模型首先学习基线条件分位数规律，然后学习由Y诱导的额外形变，从而产生一个带有条件随机化校准的全局预测增益统计量，以及一个在上下文与分位数水平上均可检查的形变场。我们还引入了结构依赖基准（SDB），用于评估受实际应用启发的依赖结构，例如上下文局部依赖、尾部依赖……（摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出QRCIT——一种基于神经分位数形变的条件独立性检验方法，通过轻量级残差分位数流模型在学习检验统计量的同时，以可检查的形变场揭示条件分布的具体变化位置，并配套发布了结构依赖基准SDB。
en_tdlr: QRCIT is a quantile-resolution conditional independence test that uses a shared residual quantile-flow model to test conditional independence while providing an inspectable deformation field revealing where the conditional law changes, along with a new Structural Dependency Benchmark (SDB).
